newsitem.title: USA: Circle Intl says in new Thai joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Circle Intl says in new Thai joint venture.

text.p: Circle International said it has launched a joint venture partnership with Worldbridge Transportation intended to expand its presence in Thailand's growing logistics market.
Circle, the main operating subsidiary of the Harper Group, will be controlling shareholder. Worldbridge Transportation is a professional logistics company headquartered in Thailand.

The new venture is called Circle Worldbridge International and provides full service logistics, said Circle. The company is based in and has a full-service office in Bangkok and another in the Bangkok airport Import & Export facilities.
In addition, the company will open a new office in Laem Chabang to provide addition support for ocean shippers. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
